fields.FIR_Description: As per the preliminary report recorded on 2025-02-06, a resident near Kalai Nagar College Road in Tirunelveli noticed repeated night-time loading of unmarked packages, and suspected illegal transport. The time of the incident was given as 19:10 on 2025-02-06. Deepa Selvam reported the matter orally at Tirunelveli Junction PS; the contact number given was 9000000413. Prakash Muthu was mentioned as a person who was present nearby, but no contact number was available. A car bearing the number TN-33-XX-1072 was seen leaving the area. A person named Hariharan Palanisamy, associated with the number 9000000463, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. The complainant mentioned CCTV footage.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Repeated night-time loading of unmarked packages reportedly noticed by residents. A car was reportedly used to leave the area.
fields.Keywords: suspected narcotics, transport, suspect, car, witness, college road, mobile number, evening
